notes:
What's new

- Presentations open as decks: PowerPoint (.pptx) and OpenDocument (.odp) slides show a numbered slide strip beside the current slide, with its title and bullet points.
- Click any slide in the strip to jump to it; the header shows the deck size and your position (SLIDE 1 / 3).
- Office documents now load in one package pass, so large decks open several times faster.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.17 - presentation preview (1C complete). PPTX reads presentation.xml order + slide parts (title/body placeholders, bullet levels, graphic frames); ODP reads draw:page frames by presentation class. Slide strip with click-to-switch, title + bullets, SLIDE n / m counter. All Office parts are read from one extracted package, cutting a 60-slide deck from 6.1s to under the budget. 17 new checks; office suite now 58.
